projection.document_shell: The retained byte hash binds the complete XML member. XML declaration, external DOCTYPE identifiers, and the exact two pre-root comments are recorded in source-accountability; the external DTD is not fetched or asserted as retained.
projection.ThML_root: TEI document root; root-only formatting whitespace is recorded in source-accountability.
projection.ThML.head: Preserve every source element, ordered value, attribute, direct text, and child tail in a typed source-header note within teiHeader/sourceDesc; do not silently adopt DC roles as catalog metadata.
projection.ThML.body: Preserve all ten direct div1 carriers and descendants, in document order, within one TEI body; do not split, reorder, or discard front matter or indexes.
projection.all_elements: Emit a deterministic source-to-TEI crosswalk for every parsed source element, including native path, tag, id, all attributes, direct text, tail, and target XML ID.
projection.attributes: Map only explicitly declared TEI-safe attributes; preserve every original attribute/value in the crosswalk. Unmapped attribute semantics remain a review question.
projection.internal_links: Resolve every fragment against the unique source id map and retarget to the deterministic TEI xml:id; fail closed on an unresolved local fragment.
projection.unknown_elements: Use seg with type thml-{exact-source-tag}; preserve content, order, attributes in crosswalk, and source element identity without claiming semantic equivalence.
projection.title_attributes: Represent div title attributes as a head unless a direct source heading already carries the same normalized text; record derived heads in accountability.
projection.later_heading_carriers: Within body/div, h1/h2/h3 after an emitted p, ab, div, lg, list, or table map to ab @type=thml-{exact-source-tag}. Preserve source position, ID, rendition, direct text, inline references, notes, and tails; do not infer a division or heading scope. Opening headings remain head. The pinned P5 div content model restricts head to divTop before component content. Actual examples include ix.viii-p0.2 (src-13123), ix.viii-p0.6, and ix.viii-p1.1; preface and other sermon occurrences follow the same rule.
projection.direct_inline_in_block: Wrap a source phrase-only carrier occurring directly in a TEI body/div in a p @rend=thml-inline-run; retain source order and carrier identity.
